verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents an official `bq` CLI that creates datasets, loads data and queries tables, plus ODBC/JDBC drivers and SDKs that connect applications programmatically, so an agent can run SQL with no dashboard. Governance comes from predefined IAM roles on datasets, tables, views and routines and from custom daily quotas, and an official MCP Toolbox server gives agents another access path. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of headless/service-account authentication, programmatic schema discovery (listing tables and columns), result-retrieval and format details, and independent hands-on corroboration of an agent workflow.
